subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Should Telegram expose a cache-backed topic catalog/list/lookup surface to agents, and what ambiguity/freshness semantics should it use for routing by human topic title?
rationale: The remaining work adds a public agent/tool/channel contract and misrouting-sensitive behavior; automation should not choose lookup semantics or stale-cache behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Expose a catalog/list lookup
options.body: Add a Telegram plugin action or metadata endpoint that returns known `topic_id <-> title` entries and fails closed on unknown or ambiguous names.

options.title: Keep numeric ids only
options.body: Keep current behavior and require users or local config to supply numeric topic ids for cross-topic routing.

options.title: Fold into broader topic management
options.body: Track name lookup together with Telegram topic lifecycle work, accepting a larger feature scope before implementation starts.

recommendation.title: Expose a catalog/list lookup
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram plugin action or metadata endpoint that returns known `topic_id <-> title` entries and fails closed on unknown or ambiguous names.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus has the strongest merged-history signal across the topic-name cache, review, and persistence path this decision would extend.
